what: A floating 60px round chat button at the bottom right of the screen — on hover the shadow deepens (.2s ease-out), on press the speech-bubble icon rotates 45° and shrinks to .7× as it vanishes while the X stands upright from -45° (.3s), and a chat window (375px wide, screen height −118px, up to 667px) rises 20px from below into place 20px above the button and turns on (.3s). The loading ring inside the window spins for .8s and clears in .3s. Below 460px the window covers the whole screen and is closed with the in-window close button — a floating button on an intro page with an inquiry and support desk attached

options.wait: Gap from press to the window opening (s), default 0 — for mimicking widgets that draw the window and then open it
options.load: Time in seconds for the loading circle to spin, default .8 — only when there is a loader child
options.--fx-gap: Distance between button and screen edge (via style), default 20px
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Round button — two children inside: icon and close
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Chat bubble icon (SVG) shown when closed
options.[data-fx-part=close]: When open, the X stands — empty <span>, the line is drawn by css
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Dialog window — whoever writes the inside fills it
options.[data-fx-part=dismiss]: Close button inside the window (optional) — under 460px the window covers the button, so it is good to include one

use: …
note: The original is an external chat widget, so there is no in-window conversation — the window is an empty panel for the user to fill. Esc also closes it

from.where: index.html .jp-chat — original chat widget CSS: button 4.2857em (60px), right/bottom 1.4286em (20px), ::after shadow opacity .2s ease-out, icon rotate(45deg) scale(.7), X rotate(-45deg)→0 .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), window right 20px, bottom 100px, 375px wide, radius 10px, translateY(20px)→0 .3s, height min(innerHeight−118, 667), and below 460px it covers the whole screen.
